description: Unthread is a B2B support platform for engineering and product teams. This plugin connects your Unthread workspace to ChatGPT through a compact, discovery-driven tool surface: search the underlying Unthread API, fetch schemas on demand, and run read or write operations gated by access class. Use it to investigate conversations, triage high-priority tickets, monitor SLAs and analytics, query your knowledge base, and create or update tickets.
